# GptGate RTL

> Open-source Windows companion that adds runtime Persian and Arabic RTL support to the official ChatGPT desktop app without patching its installed files.

## Start here

- README.md: user guide, installation, behavior, and architecture overview
- AGENTS.md: repository-specific instructions for coding agents
- CONTRIBUTING.md: contribution workflow and quality expectations
- SECURITY.md: private vulnerability reporting policy
- THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: bundled third-party software and licenses

## Project map

- CodexRtlManager/: .NET 8 WPF application
- CodexRtlManager/MainWindow.xaml: presentation and visual structure
- CodexRtlManager/Services/CodexLocator.cs: ChatGPT installation discovery
- CodexRtlManager/Services/RuntimeRtlService.cs: local DevTools connection and runtime injection
- CodexRtlManager/Services/RuntimeRtlPayload.cs: DOM observer and RTL/LTR behavior
- CodexRtlManager/Services/CodexManagerService.cs: application orchestration
- CodexRtlManager.Tests/: executable test suite
- .github/workflows/: CI and tagged release automation
- update.json: public update manifest for the latest Windows release

## Validate changes

```powershell
dotnet build .\CodexRtlManager\CodexRtlManager.csproj -c Release
dotnet run --project .\CodexRtlManager.Tests\CodexRtlManager.Tests.csproj -c Release
```

## Important constraints

- Do not patch or overwrite the installed ChatGPT or Microsoft Store package files.
- Keep DevTools communication restricted to the local loopback interface.
- Preserve LTR behavior for code, terminals, and editable fields.
- Preserve Persian RTL behavior and the existing GptGate dark visual language.
- Do not redistribute proprietary fonts; Arad is bundled under SIL OFL 1.1.
- Never commit secrets, access tokens, generated build output, or user-specific paths.
